blocks.goal: Extract the cohesive responsibility that adapts BitField operations to the smaller primitive types (byte/short) into a new production class so that BitField's implementation size (LOC) is reduced and the primitive-adaptation logic is isolated.

expected_impact.rationale: This extraction moves the implementations of the byte/short adapter methods out of BitField into a dedicated class (BitFieldPrimitives). BitField will keep its public API (the small-primitive methods remain as delegating wrappers to preserve compatibility and compilation), but the bodies will be replaced with calls to BitFieldPrimitives, reducing the LOC and concentrating primitive-specific logic in one place. Because wrappers are retained for compilation compatibility, public and total method counts in BitField do not change in this block; the primary benefit is LOC reduction and improved modularity for the primitive-adaptation responsibility.

ops.details: Create a new class org.apache.commons.lang3.BitFieldPrimitives that encapsulates the primitive-adaptation responsibility: implementations for byte- and short-focused operations are moved into this class. Extracted implementations (as static methods) include: clearByte(byte holder, long mask), clearShort(short holder, long mask), setByte(byte holder, long mask), setByteBoolean(byte holder, boolean flag, long mask), setShort(short holder, long mask), setShortBoolean(short holder, boolean flag, long mask), getShortRawValue(short holder, long mask), getShortValue(short holder, int shiftCount, long mask), setShortValue(short holder, short value, int shiftCount, long mask). The methods are designed to be static helpers that accept the necessary BitField state (mask and shiftCount) as parameters to avoid duplicating mutable state. Update BitField so that the public byte/short methods (clearByte, clearShort, setByte, setByteBoolean, setShort, setShortBoolean, getShortRawValue, getShortValue, setShortValue) become thin delegating wrappers that call the corresponding BitFieldPrimitives static methods, passing this.mask and this.shiftCount where needed. No public signatures are removed in BitField to preserve compilation; only method bodies are relocated. The new class is placed in the same package org.apache.commons.lang3 and documents that it is an extraction of primitive adapters for BitField.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
